title.value: Statistical Guarantees for Variational Autoencoders using PAC-Bayesian Theory
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the paper's main focus on deriving statistical guarantees for Variational Autoencoders using PAC-Bayesian theory.
title.quote: Statistical Guarantees for Variational Autoencoders using PAC-Bayesian Theory

extractions.description: This paper develops statistical guarantees for Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) using PAC-Bayesian theory. It provides generalization guarantees for VAEs' reconstruction loss and upper bounds on the distance between input and regenerated distributions, including the Wasserstein distance between the input distribution and the VAE’s generative model.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses primarily on theoretical and statistical aspects of machine learning models, specifically Variational Autoencoders, using PAC-Bayesian theory. It does not address climate or ecological sustainable development directly.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Since their inception, Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) have become central in machine learning. Despite their widespread use, numerous questions regarding their theoretical properties remain open. Using PAC-Bayesian theory, this work develops statistical guarantees for VAEs.
